shellCommands.command: find /workspace -type f -not -path "*/node_modules/*" -not -path "*/.git/*" -not -path "*/.next/*" | head -100
node -e "const r=require('react'); console.log('react version:', r.version); console.log('ViewTransition keys:', Object.keys(r).filter(k=>/View|unstable|Transition/i.test(k)))"

git diff package.json; echo "--- installed next:"; node -e "console.log(require('next/package.json').version)"; echo "--- compiled react channels:"; ls node_modules/next/dist/compiled | grep -i "^react"

cd /workspace
echo "=== unstable_ViewTransition in compiled react-experimental:"
node -e "const r=require('next/dist/compiled/react-experimental'); console.log(Object.keys(r).filter(k=>/View|Activity|addTransitionType/i.test(k)))"
echo "=== viewTransition in next config schema/types:"
grep -rn "viewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.js | head -5
grep -rn "viewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts | head -5

cd /workspace
echo "=== grep viewTransition in next/dist (excluding esm dupes):"
grep -rln "viewTransition" node_modules/next/dist --include=*.js --include=*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | grep -v "/esm/" | head -30

cd /workspace
echo "=== stable compiled react exports:"
node -e "const r=require('next/dist/compiled/react'); console.log(Object.keys(r).filter(k=>/View|Activity|addTransitionType/i.test(k)))"
echo "=== ViewTransition in next dist non-compiled:"
grep -rln "ViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist --include=*.js --include=*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | grep -v "/compiled/" | grep -v "/esm/" | head -30

cd /workspace
echo "=== link.d.ts ViewTransition context:"
grep -n -B4 -A8 "ViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/client/link.d.ts
echo ""
echo "=== app-router-context ViewTransition:"
grep -n -B4 -A8 "ViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/shared/lib/app-router-context.shared-runtime.d.ts

cd /workspace
echo "=== config-shared transition keys:"
grep -n -i "transition" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts | head -20
echo "=== config-schema transition:"
grep -o -i "[a-zA-Z]*ransition[a-zA-Z]*" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.js | sort -u | head
echo "=== navigation.d.ts / router push options:"
grep -rn "transitionTypes" node_modules/next/dist/client/components/*.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/client/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20

cd /workspace
echo "=== @types/react version:"; node -e "console.log(require('@types/react/package.json').version)"
echo "=== ViewTransition/addTransitionType in @types/react:"
grep -n "ViewTransition\|addTransitionType" node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts | head -20
echo "=== experimental.d.ts?"; ls node_modules/@types/react/
echo "=== canary/experimental decls:"
grep -n "ViewTransition" node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts node_modules/@types/react/experimental.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head

cd /workspace
sed -n '120,260p' node_modules/@types/react/experimental.d.ts

cd /workspace
sed -n '30,140p' node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts

cd /workspace
echo "=== react-server condition exports (compiled react):"
node -e "
const r=require('next/dist/compiled/react/react.react-server.js');
console.log(Object.keys(r).filter(k=>/View|Activity|addTransitionType|Suspense/i.test(k)));
" 2>&1 | head
echo "=== REACT_VIEW_TRANSITION_TYPE in flight server:"
grep -o "react.view_transition" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-server-dom-turbopack/cjs/react-server-dom-turbopack-server.node.production.js | sort -u | head
echo "=== addTransitionType usage in next client:"
grep -rn "addTransitionType" node_modules/next/dist/client --include=*.js | grep -v "/esm/" | head

cd /workspace
sed -n '60,110p' node_modules/next/dist/client/components/sequential-router-queue.js

cd /workspace
echo "=== @types/react exports map:"
node -e "const p=require('@types/react/package.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify({exports:p.exports, typesVersions:p.typesVersions}, null, 2))" 2>&1 | head -40
echo ""
echo "=== does Next alias react for app dir? (createRSCAliases / react\$ )"
grep -rn "react\$" node_modules/next/dist/build/create-compiler-aliases.js 2>/dev/null | head -20

cd /workspace
ls node_modules/next/dist/build/ | grep -i alias
echo "---"
grep -rn "compiled/react\b\|createRSCAliases\|getReactAliases" node_modules/next/dist/build/*.js 2>/dev/null | grep -v "/esm/" | head -20
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -40
npx next build 2>&1 | tail -40

(npx next start -p 3111 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6
echo "=== / status:"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3111/
echo "=== /product/classic-sneakers status:"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3111/product/classic-sneakers
echo "=== detail page contains hero + skeleton:"
curl -s http://localhost:3111/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o 'product-hero\|skeleton-text\|product-info' | sort | uniq -c
echo "=== view_transition markers in RSC payload:"
curl -s http://localhost:3111/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o 'view_transition\|product-image-classic-sneakers\|vt-product-image\|nav-back' | sort | uniq -c

cd /workspace
echo "=== playwright/puppeteer in node_modules:"; ls node_modules 2>/dev/null | grep -i "playwright\|puppeteer" || echo none
echo "=== chrome binaries:"; which google-chrome chromium chromium-browser google-chrome-stable 2>/dev/null || echo none
echo "=== cached browsers:"; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright ~/.cache/puppeteer 2>/dev/null || echo none
cd /tmp && timeout 300 npx --yes playwright@1.49.1 install chromium --with-deps 2>&1 | tail -5 || timeout 300 npx --yes playwright@1.49.1 install chromium 2>&1 | tail -8
cd /tmp && timeout 420 npx --yes playwright@1.49.1 install chromium 2>&1 | tail -8; echo "---"; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null

SHELL_BIN=$(ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium_headless_shell-1148/chrome-linux/headless_shell 2>/dev/null)
echo "bin: $SHELL_BIN"
ldd "$SHELL_BIN" 2>&1 | grep "not found" | sort -u | head -20
echo "=== try run:"
"$SHELL_BIN" --no-sandbox --version 2>&1 | head -5

cd /workspace
CSS=$(find .next -name "*.css" -path "*static*" | head -5); echo "files: $CSS"
for f in $CSS; do
  echo "=== $f"
  grep -o '::view-transition-old(\.vt-page-forward)\|::view-transition-new(\.vt-page-forward)\|::view-transition-old(\.vt-page-back)\|::view-transition-new(\.vt-page-back)\|::view-transition-old(\.vt-page-fade)\|::view-transition-group(\.vt-product-image)\|::view-transition-group(\.vt-reveal)\|::view-transition-group(\*)\|prefers-reduced-motion' "$f" | sort | uniq -c
done

cd /workspace
python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
css = open('.next/static/chunks/1fhjvwf_-y8m3.css').read()
i = css.find('--vt-duration')
print(css[i-20:] if i>=0 else "vars not found")
EOF
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -20 && npx next build 2>&1 | tail -15

cd /workspace
f=$(find .next -name "*.css" -path "*static*" | head -1)
python3 -c "
css=open('$f').read()
i=css.find('--vt-duration')
print(css[max(0,i-40):])
"

cd /workspace
pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1
(npx next start -p 3112 > /tmp/next2.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6
for u in / /product/classic-sneakers /product/cotton-hoodie /product/nope; do
  printf "%-32s %s\n" "$u" "$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:3112$u)"
done
echo "=== grid page: per-product shared names + forward type:"
curl -s http://localhost:3112/ | grep -o 'product-image-[a-z-]*\|nav-forward\|vt-product-image\|vt-reveal' | sort | uniq -c
pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; echo done

cd /workspace
(npx next start -p 3113 > /tmp/next3.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 7
for u in / /product/classic-sneakers /product/cotton-hoodie /product/nope; do
  printf "%-32s %s\n" "$u" "$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:3113$u)"
done
echo "=== grid page markers:"
curl -s http://localhost:3113/ | grep -o 'product-image-[a-z-]*\|nav-forward\|vt-product-image\|vt-reveal' | sort | uniq -c
cd /workspace; pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; git --no-pager diff --stat -- app lib; echo "--- untracked:"; git status --porcelain -- react-canary.d.ts lib/transitions.ts; true
cd /workspace; git --no-pager diff --stat -- app lib; echo "--- new files:"; git status --porcelain | grep -v package-lock
cd /workspace; echo "=== .gitignore:"; cat .gitignore; echo "=== tsconfig diff:"; git --no-pager diff tsconfig.json

cd /workspace
git checkout tsconfig.json
rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts tsconfig.tsbuildinfo
git status --porcelain | grep -v package-lock

cd /workspace
npx next build 2>&1 | tail -8
echo "=== tsc from clean tree:"
npx tsc --noEmit && echo "typecheck OK"
git checkout tsconfig.json 2>/dev/null; rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts tsconfig.tsbuildinfo
echo "=== final tree:"; git status --porcelain | grep -v package-lock
